result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content is clipped at the right edge without clear affordance, the bottom navigation has an overlapping home-indicator bar, and some text elements are truncated.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal card row and the category filter chips are clipped at the right screen edge (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol...' card and a partially visible chip), with no visible scroll indicator or fade affordance to signal that more content exists off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge gradient fade or partial-card peek with a scroll hint, and ensure horizontal scroll containers clearly communicate scrollability.

issues.description: The device home-indicator bar overlaps the bottom navigation icons (search and bookmark), creating visual clutter and potential tap-target interference at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding to the tab bar so navigation icons sit above the home indicator.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a clear ellipsis treatment in the 'Fastest near you' section, making the name hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent text truncation with ellipsis or allow two-line wrapping for restaurant names.

issues.description: The notification bell icon's red badge dot is very small and lacks a count, which may be easily missed and provides limited information.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly larger badge with a notification count, or ensure the dot meets minimum touch/visibility size guidelines.
